definition_ar: أداة تنكير تُستخدم قبل الاسم المفرد المعدود للإشارة إلى شيء غير محدد أو يُذكر للمرة الأولى.
definition_en: Used before a singular countable noun to refer to a person or thing that is not specific.

examples.sentence: I have a book.
She eats an apple every day.
He lives in a big house.

definition_ar: عَنْ أو حَوْلَ موضوعٍ مُعَيَّن.
definition_en: On the subject of something, or connected with it.

examples.sentence: This book is about animals.
We are talking about our holiday.
What is the movie about?

definition_ar: فَوْقَ، فِي مَكَانٍ أَعْلَى مِنْ شَيْءٍ آخَر
definition_en: In or to a higher place than something else.

examples.sentence: The picture is on the wall above the bed.
The birds are flying above the trees.
There is a clock above the door.

definition_ar: من جانب إلى الجانب الآخر من شيء ما، أو في الجانب المقابل.
definition_en: From one side to the other side of something.

examples.sentence: She walked across the street.
The store is across the road.
examples.translation_ar: المتجر يقع في الجانب الآخر من الطريق.

examples.sentence: Can you swim across the river?

definition_ar: شيء تفعله أو تصرف تقوم به.
definition_en: Something that you do.

examples.sentence: I like to watch action movies.
Think before you take action.
examples.translation_ar: فكر قبل أن تتخذ أي إجراء.

examples.sentence: Every action is important.

definition_ar: شَيْءٌ تَفْعَلُهُ، غالِبًا لِلْمُتْعَةِ أَوْ لِلتَّعَلُّمِ.
definition_en: Something that you do, usually for fun or learning.

examples.sentence: Swimming is a fun activity.
We do many activities at school.
examples.translation_ar: نقوم بالكثير من الأنشطة في المدرسة.

examples.sentence: Reading is my favorite quiet activity.

definition_ar: شَخْصٌ يُمَثِّلُ فِي الأَفْلاَمِ أَوْ المَسْرَحِيَّاتِ أَوْ البَرَامِجِ التِّلْفِزْيُونِيَّةِ (مُمَثِّل).
definition_en: A person who performs in movies, plays, or TV shows.

examples.sentence: He is a famous actor in my country.
My brother wants to be an actor.
I saw a popular actor at the restaurant.

definition_ar: امرأة تمثّل في الأفلام أو المسرحيات أو البرامج التلفزيونية.
definition_en: A woman who acts in a movie, play, or show.

examples.sentence: She is a famous actress.
My sister wants to be an actress.
The actress lives in a big city.

definition_ar: أن تضع شيئًا مع شيء آخر ليزيد عدده أو مقداره، أو أن تجمع أرقامًا معًا.
definition_en: To put something together with another thing, or to join numbers together.

examples.sentence: Please add some sugar to my coffee.
examples.translation_ar: من فضلك أضف بعض السكر إلى قهوتي.

examples.sentence: If you add two and two, you get four.
examples.translation_ar: إذا أضفت اثنين إلى اثنين، تحصل على أربعة.

examples.sentence: Can I add your name to the list?
examples.translation_ar: هل يمكنني إضافة اسمك إلى القائمة؟

definition_ar: رأي أو اقتراح يُقدّمه لك شخص ما لمساعدتك على اتخاذ قرار.
definition_en: An opinion or suggestion that someone gives you to help you.

examples.sentence: Thank you for your advice.
My teacher gives me good advice.
I need some advice about my English.
examples.translation_ar: أحتاج إلى بعض النصائح بشأن لغتي الإنجليزية.

definition_ar: خائف؛ الشعور بالخوف أو القلق من شيء ما.
definition_en: Feeling fear or scared of something.

examples.sentence: Don't be afraid, the dog is friendly.
She is afraid of the dark.
Are you afraid of spiders?

definition_ar: فترة بعد الظهيرة، وهي الوقت الممتد من منتصف النهار حتى بداية المساء.
definition_en: The period of time between noon and evening.

examples.sentence: Good afternoon, how can I help you?
I usually read a book in the afternoon.
examples.translation_ar: عادة ما أقرأ كتابًا في فترة بعد الظهيرة.

examples.sentence: We are going to the park this afternoon.
examples.translation_ar: سنذهب إلى الحديقة بعد ظهر اليوم.

definition_ar: مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، كَرَّةً ثَانِيَةً أَوْ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.
definition_en: One more time or once more.

examples.sentence: Can you say that again, please?
examples.translation_ar: هل يمكنك قول ذلك مرة أخرى، من فضلك؟

examples.sentence: See you again tomorrow.
Please try again.

definition_ar: قَبْلَ / مَضَتْ (تُسْتَخْدَمُ بَعْدَ فَتْرَةٍ زَمَنِيَّةٍ لِلْإِشَارَةِ إِلَى وَقْتٍ فِي الْمَاضِي)
definition_en: Back in time from the present; before now.

examples.sentence: I arrived here ten minutes ago.
examples.translation_ar: وَصَلْتُ إِلَى هُنَا قَبْلَ عَشْرِ دَقَائِقَ.

examples.sentence: They moved to London two years ago.
The train left a few moments ago.

definition_ar: أن يكون لديك نفس الرأي مع شخص آخر، أو أن توافق على اقتراح أو فكرة.
definition_en: To have the same opinion as someone else, or to say yes to an idea.

examples.sentence: I agree with you.
We agreed to meet at five o'clock.
examples.translation_ar: اتفقنا على اللقاء في الساعة الخامسة.

examples.sentence: Do you agree with my plan?

definition_ar: الهواء الذي نتنفسه ويحيط بالكرة الأرضية.
definition_en: The invisible gas around the Earth that people and animals breathe.

examples.sentence: I need some fresh air.
Birds fly in the air.
Open the window to let in some air.

definition_ar: مَكَانٌ تَهْبِطُ فِيهِ الطَّائِرَاتُ وَتُقْلِعُ مِنْهُ وَيُسَافِرُ عَبْرَهُ النَّاسُ.
definition_en: A place where planes take off and land, and where passengers get on and off planes.

examples.sentence: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
examples.translation_ar: وَصَلْنَا إِلَى الْمَطَارِ قَبْلَ سَاعَتَيْنِ مِنْ مَوْعِدِ رِحْلَتِنَا.

examples.sentence: The airport is very big and busy today.
My brother works at the airport.

definition_ar: أيضًا؛ بالإضافة إلى ذلك
definition_en: in addition, or too

examples.sentence: She speaks English, and she also speaks French.
examples.translation_ar: هي تتحدث الإنجليزية، وتتحدث الفرنسية أيضًا.

examples.sentence: I like apples, and I also like bananas.
examples.translation_ar: أنا أحب التفاح، وأحب الموز أيضًا.

examples.sentence: He is a student, and he also works part-time.
examples.translation_ar: هو طالب، ويعمل أيضًا بدوام جزئي.

definition_ar: مدهش أو رائع للغاية
definition_en: Very good, surprising, or impressive.

examples.sentence: The food at this restaurant is amazing.
examples.translation_ar: الطعام في هذا المطعم رائع جداً.

examples.sentence: She is an amazing singer.
We had an amazing day at the beach.

definition_ar: حرف عطف يُستخدم للربط بين الكلمات أو العبارات أو الجمل.
definition_en: Used to connect words, phrases, or sentences.

examples.sentence: I like tea and coffee.
She has a cat and a dog.
He stood up and walked to the door.

definition_ar: كائن حي ليس نباتًا ولا إنسانًا، مثل الكلب أو القط أو الأسد.
definition_en: A living creature that is not a plant or a human being.

examples.sentence: The dog is a friendly animal.
What is your favorite animal?
We saw many animals at the zoo.
examples.translation_ar: رأينا العديد من الحيوانات في حديقة الحيوان.

definition_ar: في كل وقت، طوال الوقت.
definition_en: At all times; every time.

examples.sentence: I always drink coffee in the morning.
examples.translation_ar: أنا أشرب القهوة دائماً في الصباح.

examples.sentence: She is always happy to help.
The sun always rises in the east.

definition_ar: شعور بالغضب أو الانزعاج.
definition_en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance or hostility.

examples.sentence: He was angry because he lost his keys.
Please don't be angry with me.
The teacher was angry at the noisy students.
examples.translation_ar: كان المعلم غاضباً من الطلاب المزعجين.

definition_ar: واحد إضافي أو مختلف.
definition_en: One more or a different one.

examples.sentence: Can I have another cup of tea?
examples.translation_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على كوب آخر من الشاي؟

examples.sentence: I need another pen, this one is broken.
examples.translation_ar: أحتاج إلى قلم آخر، هذا القلم مكسور.

examples.sentence: Let's meet another day.

definition_ar: رد أو استجابة لسؤال أو موقف.
definition_en: A thing said, written, or done to deal with a question or situation.

examples.sentence: Do you know the answer to this question?
She gave a short answer.
I am waiting for an answer from him.

definition_ar: أي شخص.
definition_en: Any person or people.

examples.sentence: Is anyone here?
I didn't see anyone at the park.
examples.translation_ar: لم أرَ أي شخص في الحديقة.

examples.sentence: Anyone can learn to play the piano.
examples.translation_ar: أي شخص يمكنه تعلم عزف البيانو.

definition_ar: أي شيء، يستخدم عادة في الأسئلة أو الجمل المنفية.
definition_en: Used to refer to a thing, no matter what it is.

examples.sentence: Do you need anything from the shop?
examples.translation_ar: هل تحتاج أي شيء من المتجر؟

examples.sentence: I don't have anything to eat.
Is there anything in the box?
examples.translation_ar: هل يوجد أي شيء في الصندوق؟

definition_ar: شقة، مجموعة من الغرف للسكن داخل مبنى أكبر.
definition_en: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building.

examples.sentence: I live in a small apartment.
His apartment is near the park.
She wants to rent a new apartment.

definition_ar: تفاحة، فاكهة مستديرة ذات قشرة حمراء أو خضراء.
definition_en: A round fruit with red or green skin and white flesh.

examples.sentence: I eat an apple every morning.
This apple is very sweet.
Would you like a red apple?
examples.translation_ar: هل تود الحصول على تفاحة حمراء؟

definition_ar: أبريل، الشهر الرابع من السنة.
definition_en: The fourth month of the year.

examples.sentence: My birthday is in April.
The weather is nice in April.
We are traveling in April.

definition_ar: منطقة، جزء معين من مكان أو بلد.
definition_en: A particular part of a place or country.

examples.sentence: This is a quiet area.
Do you live in this area?
There is a park in our area.

definition_ar: جزء من جسم الإنسان يمتد من الكتف إلى اليد.
definition_en: A part of the human body that extends from the shoulder to the hand.

examples.sentence: She has a long arm.
He hurt his arm playing football.
examples.translation_ar: أصيب في ذراعه أثناء لعب كرة القدم.

examples.sentence: Carry the bag in your arm.

definition_ar: في كل مكان أو في محيط شيء ما.
definition_en: Located on every side of something or in many places.

examples.sentence: We sat around the table.
There are many trees around the house.
Look around you.

definition_ar: الوصول إلى مكان معين بعد رحلة أو حركة.
definition_en: To reach a place at the end of a journey.

examples.sentence: What time does the train arrive?
We arrive at school at eight o'clock.
examples.translation_ar: نصل إلى المدرسة في الساعة الثامنة.

examples.sentence: They arrive home late.

definition_ar: نشاط إبداعي مثل الرسم أو النحت.
definition_en: Creative activity such as painting, drawing, or sculpture.

examples.sentence: I like my art class.
examples.translation_ar: أنا أحب حصة الفن الخاصة بي.

examples.sentence: She is good at art.
We saw beautiful art in the museum.

definition_ar: شخص يبدع في الفنون مثل الرسم أو النحت.
definition_en: A person who creates art, such as paintings or drawings.

examples.sentence: She is a famous artist.
The artist paints beautiful pictures.
I want to be an artist.

definition_ar: أن تطلب معلومات أو شيئاً ما من شخص.
definition_en: To say something to someone to get information or to request something.

examples.sentence: Can I ask a question?
Please ask your teacher for help.
examples.translation_ar: من فضلك اطلب المساعدة من معلمك.

examples.sentence: He likes to ask about my day.
examples.translation_ar: هو يحب أن يسأل عن يومي.

definition_ar: حرف جر يستخدم لتحديد مكان أو زمان محدد.
definition_en: Used to show a specific place or time.

examples.sentence: I am at home.
The class starts at nine.
Meet me at the park.

definition_ar: الشهر الثامن من السنة الميلادية.
definition_en: The eighth month of the year.

examples.sentence: My birthday is in August.
It is very hot in August.
We go on vacation in August.
examples.translation_ar: نذهب في إجازة في شهر أغسطس.

definition_ar: أخت الأب أو أخت الأم.
definition_en: The sister of your father or mother.

examples.sentence: My aunt lives in London.
I visited my aunt yesterday.
My aunt is very kind.

definition_ar: فصل الخريف، وهو الفصل الذي يأتي بعد الصيف وقبل الشتاء.
definition_en: The season of the year between summer and winter.

examples.sentence: The leaves fall in autumn.
examples.translation_ar: تتساقط أوراق الشجر في فصل الخريف.

examples.sentence: I like the cool weather in autumn.
Autumn is my favorite season.

definition_ar: بعيداً أو إلى مكان آخر.
definition_en: To or at a distance from a particular place or person.

examples.sentence: He is away on holiday.
Please put your books away.
The park is not far away.

definition_ar: طفل رضيع صغير جداً.
definition_en: A very young child.

examples.sentence: The baby is sleeping.
She has a beautiful baby.
The baby is crying.

definition_ar: سيء أو غير جيد.
definition_en: Not good; of poor quality.

examples.sentence: I had a bad day today.
This is a bad apple.
It is bad to be late for school.
examples.translation_ar: من السيء أن تتأخر عن المدرسة.

definition_ar: حقيبة تستخدم لحمل الأشياء.
definition_en: A container made of paper, plastic, or cloth used to carry things.

examples.sentence: I have my books in my bag.
Can you carry this heavy bag?
examples.translation_ar: هل يمكنك حمل هذه الحقيبة الثقيلة؟

examples.sentence: She bought a new school bag.

definition_ar: جسم مستدير يستخدم في الألعاب والرياضة.
definition_en: A round object used for playing games and sports.

examples.sentence: The boy is playing with a ball.
I have a red ball.
Can you catch the ball?

definition_ar: فاكهة طويلة ذات قشرة صفراء.
definition_en: A long, curved fruit with a yellow skin.

examples.sentence: I eat a banana for breakfast.
This banana is very sweet.
Do you want a banana?

definition_ar: مجموعة من الأشخاص يعزفون الموسيقى معاً.
definition_en: A group of people who play music together.

examples.sentence: The band is playing music.
I like this music band.
They are in a school band.

definition_ar: عملية غسل الجسم في حوض مملوء بالماء.
definition_en: The act of washing your body in a tub filled with water.

examples.sentence: I take a bath every night.
The baby needs a bath.
The water for the bath is warm.

definition_ar: الغرفة في المنزل التي تحتوي على حوض استحمام أو مرحاض.
definition_en: A room in a house with a bath, shower, or toilet.

examples.sentence: Where is the bathroom, please?
The bathroom is very clean.
He is in the bathroom.

definition_ar: فعل كينونة يستخدم لوصف الحالة أو الهوية أو الوجود.
definition_en: To exist or to have a specific state or quality.

examples.sentence: I want to be a teacher.
They are my friends.
It is a sunny day.

definition_ar: منطقة رملية أو صخرية بجانب البحر أو المحيط.
definition_en: A sandy or stony area by the sea or ocean.

examples.sentence: We go to the beach in summer.
The beach is very clean.
I like walking on the beach.

definition_ar: شيء جميل أو جذاب للنظر.
definition_en: Very pleasant to look at or listen to.

examples.sentence: She has a beautiful smile.
The flowers are beautiful.
What a beautiful day!

definition_ar: تستخدم لبيان السبب أو التعليل.
definition_en: For the reason that.

examples.sentence: I am happy because it is my birthday.
examples.translation_ar: أنا سعيد لأن اليوم هو عيد ميلادي.

examples.sentence: He stayed home because he was tired.
examples.translation_ar: بقي في المنزل لأنه كان متعباً.

examples.sentence: I like her because she is kind.

definition_ar: أن تتحول أو تتغير لتصبح شيئاً آخر.
definition_en: To start to be something or to change into something.

examples.sentence: It is becoming cold outside.
examples.translation_ar: بدأ الجو يصبح بارداً في الخارج.

examples.sentence: She wants to become a doctor.
The caterpillar will become a butterfly.

definition_ar: قطعة أثاث ننام عليها.
definition_en: A piece of furniture that you sleep on.

examples.sentence: I go to bed at ten o'clock.
examples.translation_ar: أذهب إلى السرير في الساعة العاشرة.

examples.sentence: My bed is very comfortable.
Please make your bed.

definition_ar: غرفة في المنزل مخصصة للنوم.
definition_en: A room in a house where you sleep.

examples.sentence: My bedroom is small.
She is in her bedroom.
I have a desk in my bedroom.

definition_ar: مشروب كحولي مصنوع من الحبوب.
definition_en: An alcoholic drink made from grain.

examples.sentence: He likes to drink a cold beer.
They ordered two beers.
Do you want a beer?

definition_ar: أن تبدأ شيئاً ما.
definition_en: To start doing something.

examples.sentence: The class will begin soon.
We begin our work at eight.
When does the movie begin?

definition_ar: الجزء الأول من شيء ما.
definition_en: The first part of something.

examples.sentence: This is the beginning of the book.
I like the beginning of the song.
It is just the beginning.

definition_ar: في الجزء الخلفي من شيء ما أو في مكان يقع خلفه.
definition_en: At the back of something.

examples.sentence: The cat is behind the sofa.
I am standing behind you.
The sun went behind the clouds.

definition_ar: أن تعتقد أن شيئاً ما حقيقي أو صحيح.
definition_en: To think that something is true or real.

examples.sentence: I believe you.
Do you believe in magic?
She believes that it will rain today.

definition_ar: في مستوى أدنى من شيء ما أو تحت شيء ما.
definition_en: In a lower position than something else.

examples.sentence: The temperature is below zero.
Look at the text below.
The boat is below the bridge.

definition_ar: مركبة ذات عجلتين يتم تحريكها بواسطة الدواسات.
definition_en: A vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals.

examples.sentence: I ride my bicycle to school.
She has a new red bicycle.
My bicycle is very fast.

definition_ar: كبير في الحجم أو المقدار.
definition_en: Large in size or amount.

examples.sentence: They live in a big house.
I have a big family.
That is a big dog.

definition_ar: مركبة ذات عجلتين تُدفع بالقدمين.
definition_en: A vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals with your feet.

examples.sentence: I ride my bike to school.
My bike is red.
He has a new bike.

definition_ar: حيوان له ريش وجناحان ويبيض.
definition_en: An animal that has feathers and wings and lays eggs.

examples.sentence: The bird can fly.
I see a small bird in the tree.
The bird is singing.

definition_ar: اليوم الذي ولدت فيه، ويُحتفل به سنوياً.
definition_en: The day you were born, celebrated every year.

examples.sentence: Today is my birthday.
I have a birthday party.
Happy birthday to you!

definition_ar: لون داكن جداً، مثل لون الليل.
definition_en: A very dark color, like the color of the night.

examples.sentence: I have a black cat.
The sky is black at night.
He wears a black shirt.

definition_ar: صفحة على الإنترنت يكتب فيها الشخص أفكاره أو يومياته.
definition_en: A website where a person writes about their thoughts or daily life.

examples.sentence: She writes a blog about food.
I read his blog every day.
Do you have a blog?

definition_ar: يصف الشخص الذي لديه شعر أصفر أو فاتح اللون.
definition_en: Having yellow or very light-colored hair.

examples.sentence: She has long blonde hair.
The blonde girl is my sister.
He has blonde hair and blue eyes.

definition_ar: لون السماء الصافية أو البحر.
definition_en: The color of the clear sky or the sea.

examples.sentence: The sky is blue today.
I have a blue pen.
She is wearing a blue dress.

definition_ar: مركبة صغيرة تستخدم للتنقل فوق الماء.
definition_en: A small vehicle used for traveling on water.

examples.sentence: We went on a boat in the lake.
The boat is white.
He likes to fish from his boat.

definition_ar: الهيكل المادي للإنسان أو الحيوان.
definition_en: The physical structure of a person or an animal.

examples.sentence: Exercise is good for your body.
She washed her whole body.
The human body needs water.

definition_ar: حذاء يغطي القدم والكاحل، وأحياناً جزءاً من الساق.
definition_en: A type of shoe that covers the foot and ankle, and sometimes the lower leg.

examples.sentence: I wear my boots when it rains.
These boots are very comfortable.
He bought a new pair of leather boots.
examples.translation_ar: اشترى زوجاً جديداً من الأحذية الجلدية.

definition_ar: الشعور بالملل أو عدم الاهتمام.
definition_en: Feeling unhappy because you have nothing to do or are not interested in something.

examples.sentence: I am bored because there is nothing to do.
examples.translation_ar: أنا أشعر بالملل لأنه لا يوجد شيء لأفعله.

examples.sentence: Are you bored with this movie?
examples.translation_ar: هل تشعر بالملل من هذا الفيلم؟

examples.sentence: The students look bored in class.

definition_ar: شيء ممل أو غير ممتع.
definition_en: Not interesting; making you feel tired or impatient.

examples.sentence: This book is very boring.
It was a long and boring meeting.
I don't like this game, it is boring.
examples.translation_ar: أنا لا أحب هذه اللعبة، إنها مملة.

definition_en: A period of 12 months.

examples.sentence: There are twelve months in a year.
examples.translation_ar: يوجد اثنا عشر شهراً في السنة.

examples.sentence: I am twenty years old.
We go on vacation every year.
examples.translation_ar: نحن نذهب في إجازة كل سنة.

definition_ar: لون يشبه لون الشمس أو الليمون.
definition_en: The color of the sun or a lemon.

examples.sentence: The sun is yellow.
I have a yellow pencil.
She likes the yellow flower.

definition_ar: كلمة تستخدم للموافقة أو الإجابة بالإيجاب.
definition_en: A word used to show agreement or to say 'okay'.

examples.sentence: Yes, I am a student.
Yes, please.
She said yes to the invitation.

definition_ar: اليوم الذي سبق اليوم الحالي.
definition_en: The day before today.

examples.sentence: I was at home yesterday.
Yesterday was a sunny day.
We played football yesterday.

definition_ar: ضمير يستخدم لمخاطبة الشخص أو الأشخاص الذين تتحدث إليهم.
definition_en: The person or people that you are talking to.

examples.sentence: How are you?
I see you.
You are my friend.

definition_ar: ضمير ملكية يستخدم للإشارة إلى شيء يخص الشخص الذي تخاطبه.
definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the person you are talking to.

examples.sentence: What is your name?
This is your book.
I like your house.

definition_ar: تستخدم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي تتحدث إليه (نفسك).
definition_en: Used to refer to the person you are talking to as the object of a verb or preposition.

examples.sentence: Did you hurt yourself?
You should believe in yourself.
Please help yourself to some food.
examples.translation_ar: من فضلك خذ ما تشاء من الطعام.
